verifiedWith.probe: scripts/native-mutation-conformance-runner.mjs (undo-v18: complete browser operation set, native Undo/Redo, save/reopen, change budget, visual, playback and PowerPoint evidence)

aiExposure.policy: Expose every bounded operation except format-excluded mutations. Before execution, authorize against the current document permission and the live editor engine patch level. Availability records release-evidence maturity; it does not silently remove an implemented operation from the model schema.

transaction.targetResolution: Targets are captured from one observed revision and rebound to the same live UNO objects before every command.
transaction.ordering: Element and creation batches use the editor command domain and commit as one native Undo action. On the stock engine a structure-changing slide command must be the only command in its transaction; multi-command slide-structure batches require the verified engine patch because stock page moves can rename existing objects. An identity-replacing operation must be the only command in its transaction so no later command can target the replaced native object.

editor.description: Commands executed against live editor objects and grouped by the document XUndoManager.

slide_transform.description: Typed document-structure commands executed by LibreOffice as one SfxUndoManager list action.

platform_asset.description: Binary assets are authorized and delivered by the host, then inserted into the live editor as one native Undo action; models never receive file or network authority.

changeBudgetContract.scope: Target-scoped categories are resolved through the saved presentation relationship graph; unclassified package parts fail closed.

formatExcludedOperations.reason: PresentationML has no per-shape printable flag. LibreOffice's UNO Printable property is not representable in PPTX, so exposing it would promise state that the original format cannot preserve.

PowerPoint 3-D effects (a:scene3d/a:sp3d) import into LibreOffice only as preserved interop data; there is no editable 3-D model for them. The UNO D3DMaterial properties belong to LibreOffice 3-D scene objects, which PPTX cannot store, so the edit would not survive save.

The pinned LibreOffice PPTX importer rejects mc:Choice Requires="a14" and loads an Office Math equation as its fallback picture. No editable formula object exists for a PPTX equation, so the equation is preserved as authored but cannot be edited.

knownUnsafeTransactions.reason: The stock engine can rename objects during page moves. The declared patched engine preserves identity and passed multi-command Undo, save/reopen and change-budget conformance; lower patch levels remain rejected.
Slide-structure transforms and element edits use different native command domains. They remain separate transactions until the patched engine proves identity-preserving unified Undo and rollback.

sections.description: Complete ordered section definition. Non-empty lists must start at slide 0 and use strictly increasing startSlideIndex values. Preserve observed ids when retaining sections; generate a new braced UUID for a new section.

masterIndex.description: Exact master index from the current native observation. Required by set_slide_layout and set_master_theme.

scaleContent.description: When changing slide size, scale existing slide and master objects with the page.

interaction.description: Bounded PowerPoint click behavior. External URLs permit only credential-free HTTP(S); internal_slide requires targetSlideIndex.

duration.description: Auto-advance interval in seconds; setting it also enables automatic advance.

autoAdvance.description: Whether the slide advances automatically. A false value cannot be combined with duration.

animationId.description: Exact animation effect id from the current native observation.

animationIndex.description: Requested global effect position from the current slide animation observation.

presetId.description: LibreOffice/OpenDocument animation preset id preserved by PPTX round-trip.

duration.description: Object animation effect duration in seconds.

delay.description: Object animation effect delay in seconds.

assetId.description: Document-scoped asset id returned by the host. The model never supplies a URL or path.

smartartNode.description: One semantic SmartArt data node. Replacement/deletion is stale-guarded by its observed text and occurrence; add uses text with expectedText null.

preset.description: PowerPoint WordArt transform (a:prstTxWarp preset) for an observed WordArt shape.

size.description: font_size in points; line_width in millimetres.

spacing.description: PowerPoint character spacing in points; null when unused.

languageTag.description: BCP 47 language tag applied to Latin, East Asian and complex-script text runs.

lineStyle.description: PowerPoint line presets: the dash, and the arrowhead at the line's start and end with its width and length (medium when null). A null dash or line end keeps its current value.

shapeFill.description: No fill, a solid color, or an existing gradient/hatch from the observed document catalog. Arbitrary unobserved style names are rejected.

rowDescriptions.description: Chart category labels. When provided, the array length must equal the observed chart rowCount.

columnDescriptions.description: Chart series labels. When provided, the array length must equal the observed chart columnCount.

chartType.description: Bounded internal-data chart family for set_chart_type.

rows.description: Target vertical subdivision count for split_table_cell; 1 keeps the current vertical division.

columns.description: Target horizontal subdivision count for split_table_cell; 1 keeps the current horizontal division.

Paragraph geometry and direction changes require explicit native UNO value restoration on Undo and Redo.
Section mutations require a document-level section snapshot and PPTX round-trip patch.
Connector creation requires native identity, endpoint and geometry Undo support.
Freeform creation requires native path identity and geometry Undo support.
Connector endpoint and attachment changes require native attribute and geometry Undo support.
Gradient and hatch catalog changes require native style-catalog validation and Undo support.

Language changes across Latin, Asian and complex scripts require the declared native text patch.
Case-map changes require the declared native text Undo patch.
List structure changes require native numbering-rule snapshots, paragraph-property Undo and PPTX round-trip support.
Image replacement requires a trusted host asset transfer and one native replacement Undo action.
Media replacement requires trusted host transfer and complete authored-state restoration, including values absent from the original update mask.
Media playback properties require complete authored-state restoration on Undo and Redo, even when the original MediaItem mask omitted them.
SmartArt semantic edits require diagram-model snapshots instead of destructive shape flattening.
SmartArt semantic node creation requires diagram-model snapshots and relationship preservation.
SmartArt semantic node deletion requires diagram-model snapshots and relationship preservation.
Fontwork geometry changes require native attribute Undo and PPTX round-trip support.
Accessibility reading-order changes require a complete native navigation-order snapshot.
